name: Ambler YMCA Summer Camp
description_short: Greater Philadelphia YMCA day camp for the Ambler, Blue Bell and Gwynedd area, booked a week at a time, with traditional camp built around weekly themes (STEM, crafts, swim or water play, team building, games and a field trip or in-house experience) and specialty camps. Before and after care from 7 am to 6 pm is included.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are non-refundable and can move between weeks until May 15. Cancellations or changes need 15 business days' notice before the camp week; after that the whole week's fee is non-refundable. No credit for missed days or weather closures.
notes: Four 2027 camp sites listed, each 7:00 am to 6:00 pm: Ambler YMCA (1325 McKean Road, Ambler), Blue Bell Elementary School (801 Symphony Lane, Blue Bell), Temple University Ambler (580 Meetinghouse Road, Ambler) and Wissahickon Middle School (500 Houston Road, Lower Gwynedd). Which camps run at which site, ages, dates and prices are in a planner marked 'Coming Soon'. Campers bring lunch and two snacks.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp page: weekly registration for summer 2027 opens January 6 (family members), January 13 (members) and January 20, 2027 (non-members); open to members and non-members, members pay less; before and after care included in the day camp price; camp activities 9 to 4 with care 7 am to 6 pm; traditional camp curriculum (STEM, arts and crafts, swim or water play, team building, field trip or in-house experience); lunch and snacks not provided; Financial Assistance Program; cancellation terms; camp team email and Connection Center phone. The planner with camps, ages and prices says 'Coming Soon'. Primary and secondary categories are my reading of the traditional camp curriculum.
